dct_description_sm: This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means [here](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Tags) ) : tags['waterway'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['water'] IS NOT NULL OR tags['natural'] IN ('water','wetland','bay') Features may have these attributes: - [name](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name) - [name:en](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:en) - [waterway](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:waterway) - [covered](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:covered) - [width](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:width) - [depth](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:depth) - [layer](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:layer) - [blockage](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:blockage) - [tunnel](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:tunnel) - [natural](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:natural) - [water](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:water) - [source](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:source) - [name:ar](http://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:name:ar) This dataset is one of many [OpenStreetMap exports on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot). See the [Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team](http://hotosm.org/) website for more information.
